recipes.title: A dim path light to the bathroom at night
recipes.yaml:
alias: Night path light to the bathroom
mode: restart
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.hallway_motion
    to: "on"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    after: "23:00:00"
    before: "06:00:00"
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.bathroom_path
    data:
      brightness_pct: 8
      color_temp_kelvin: 2200
  - wait_for_trigger:
      - trigger: state
        entity_id: binary_sensor.hallway_motion
        to: "off"
        for:
          seconds: 90
    timeout: "00:10:00"
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: light.bathroom_path

recipes.title: The lamp comes on when the room gets dark
recipes.yaml:
alias: Living room lamp when it gets dark
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.living_room_illuminance
    below: 40
    for:
      minutes: 5
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.living_room_presence
    state: "on"
  - condition: time
    after: "08:00:00"
    before: "22:00:00"
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.living_room_lamp
    data:
      brightness_pct: 60

recipes.title: One button switches the evening lights off
recipes.yaml:
alias: Hall button - evening lights off
triggers:
  - trigger: event.received
    target:
      entity_id: event.hall_button
    options:
      event_type:
        - single_press
actions:
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      label_id: goodnight_lights

recipes.title: The pantry light follows the door
recipes.yaml:
alias: Pantry light follows the door
mode: restart
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.pantry_door
    to: "on"
    id: opened
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.pantry_door
    to: "off"
    id: closed
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.pantry_door
    to: "on"
    for:
      minutes: 15
    id: forgotten
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: opened
        sequence:
          - action: light.turn_on
            target:
              entity_id: light.pantry
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id:
              - closed
              - forgotten
        sequence:
          - action: light.turn_off
            target:
              entity_id: light.pantry

recipes.title: The light gets warmer as the day goes on
recipes.yaml:
alias: Warmer light as the day goes on
triggers:
  - trigger: time_pattern
    minutes: "/15"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    after: "06:00:00"
    before: "23:00:00"
actions:
  - variables:
      kelvin: >
        {% set h = now().hour %}
        {{ 3000 if h < 9 else 4000 if h < 17
           else 3000 if h < 20 else 2400 }}
  - repeat:
      for_each:
        - light.living_room
        - light.kitchen
        - light.hallway
      sequence:
        - if:
            - condition: template
              value_template: >
                {{ is_state(repeat.item, 'on') }}
          then:
            - action: light.turn_on
              target:
                entity_id: "{{ repeat.item }}"
              data:
                color_temp_kelvin: "{{ kelvin | int }}"
                transition: 20

recipes.title: A bedtime fade-out
recipes.yaml:
alias: Bedroom fade-out at bedtime
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: input_button.bedtime
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.bedroom
    data:
      brightness_pct: 5
      transition: 120
  - delay:
      minutes: 3
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: light.bedroom

recipes.title: Blinds up at sunrise, but never before 07:00
recipes.yaml:
alias: Blinds up - sunrise, not before 07:00
triggers:
  - trigger: sun.sunrise
  - trigger: time
    at: "07:00:00"
conditions:
  - condition: sun.is_up
  - condition: time
    after: "07:00:00"
    weekday:
      - mon
      - tue
      - wed
      - thu
      - fri
actions:
  - action: cover.open_cover
    target:
      entity_id: cover.bedroom_blinds

recipes.title: A house mode that updates itself
recipes.yaml:
alias: House mode follows the people
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id:
      - person.anna
      - person.ben
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: input_select.house_mode
    state:
      - Home
      - Away
actions:
  - action: input_select.select_option
    target:
      entity_id: input_select.house_mode
    data:
      option: >
        {{ 'Home' if states.person
           | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'home')
           | list | count > 0 else 'Away' }}

recipes.title: A guest mode that pauses the "nobody home" rules
recipes.yaml:
alias: Guest mode on and off
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: input_boolean.guest_mode
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: state
            entity_id: input_boolean.guest_mode
            state: "on"
        sequence:
          - action: input_select.select_option
            target:
              entity_id: input_select.house_mode
            data:
              option: Guests
    default:
      - action: input_select.select_option
        target:
          entity_id: input_select.house_mode
        data:
          option: Home

recipes.title: Warm the house when you are nearly home
recipes.yaml:
alias: Heat on when someone is near home
triggers:
  - trigger: zone.entered
    target:
      entity_id:
        - person.anna
        - person.ben
    options:
      zone: zone.near_home
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: input_select.house_mode
    state: Away
  - condition: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.living_room_temperature
    below: 19
actions:
  - action: climate.set_temperature
    target:
      entity_id: climate.living_room
    data:
      temperature: 21
      hvac_mode: heat

recipes.title: A morning routine that runs once a day
recipes.yaml:
alias: Good morning - first motion of the day
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.kitchen_motion
    to: "on"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    after: "06:00:00"
    before: "10:00:00"
  - condition: template
    value_template: >
      {{ this.attributes.last_triggered is none
         or as_local(this.attributes.last_triggered)
            .date() != now().date() }}
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.kitchen
    data:
      brightness_pct: 70
  - action: cover.open_cover
    target:
      entity_id: cover.kitchen_blinds

recipes.title: A different wake-up on workdays and holidays
recipes.yaml:
alias: Wake-up light on workdays only
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "06:45:00"
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.workday_sensor
    state: "on"
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.bedroom
    data:
      brightness_pct: 25
      color_temp_kelvin: 2700
      transition: 300

recipes.title: Movie mode that puts everything back
recipes.yaml:
alias: Movie mode on
sequence:
  - action: scene.create
    data:
      scene_id: before_movie
      snapshot_entities:
        - light.living_room
        - light.kitchen
        - cover.living_room_blinds
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: light.kitchen
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.living_room
    data:
      brightness_pct: 10
  - action: cover.close_cover
    target:
      entity_id: cover.living_room_blinds
---
alias: Movie mode off
sequence:
  - action: scene.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: scene.before_movie

recipes.title: One "leaving" script for buttons, voice and automations
recipes.yaml:
alias: Leaving the house
fields:
  lock_door:
    name: Lock the front door
    default: true
    selector:
      boolean: {}
sequence:
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: all
  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ lock_door }}"
    then:
      - action: lock.lock
        target:
          entity_id: lock.front_door
  - action: climate.set_preset_mode
    target:
      entity_id: climate.living_room
    data:
      preset_mode: eco
  - action: input_select.select_option
    target:
      entity_id: input_select.house_mode
    data:
      option: Away

recipes.title: Tell only the people who are home
recipes.yaml:
alias: Mailbox opened - tell whoever is home
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.mailbox
    to: "on"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    after: "08:00:00"
    before: "20:00:00"
actions:
  - repeat:
      for_each:
        - person: person.anna
          notify: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
        - person: person.ben
          notify: notify.mobile_app_ben_phone
      sequence:
        - if:
            - condition: template
              value_template: >
                {{ is_state(repeat.item.person, 'home') }}
          then:
            - action: "{{ repeat.item.notify }}"
              data:
                title: Mailbox
                message: The mailbox was opened.

recipes.title: A reminder that asks again until you tick it off
recipes.yaml:
alias: Bins - remind until done
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "19:30:00"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    weekday:
      - tue
actions:
  - repeat:
      count: 4
      sequence:
        - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
          data:
            title: Bins
            message: Bins out tonight?
            data:
              tag: bins
              actions:
                - action: BINS_DONE
                  title: Done
                - action: BINS_LATER
                  title: In 30 minutes
        - wait_for_trigger:
            - trigger: event
              event_type: mobile_app_notification_action
              event_data:
                action: BINS_DONE
            - trigger: event
              event_type: mobile_app_notification_action
              event_data:
                action: BINS_LATER
          timeout: "00:30:00"
        - if:
            - condition: template
              value_template: >
                {{ wait.trigger is not none
                   and wait.trigger.event.data.action
                       == 'BINS_DONE' }}
          then:
            - stop: Bins done
        - if:
            - condition: template
              value_template: >
                {{ wait.trigger is not none }}
          then:
            - delay:
                minutes: 30

recipes.title: A notification that removes itself when the problem is gone
recipes.yaml:
alias: Garden gate - warn, then clear
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.garden_gate
    to: "on"
    for:
      minutes: 10
    id: open_long
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.garden_gate
    to: "off"
    id: closed
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: open_long
        sequence:
          - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
            data:
              title: Garden gate
              message: Gate open for 10 minutes.
              data:
                tag: garden_gate
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: closed
        sequence:
          - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
            data:
              message: clear_notification
              data:
                tag: garden_gate

recipes.title: One battery message on Sunday instead of ten warnings
recipes.yaml:
alias: Sunday battery digest
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "10:00:00"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    weekday:
      - sun
actions:
  - variables:
      low: >
        {% set ns = namespace(items=[]) %}
        {% for s in states.sensor
           if s.attributes.device_class | default('')
              == 'battery'
           and s.state | float(100) < 20 %}
          {% set ns.items = ns.items
             + [s.name ~ ' ' ~ s.state ~ '%'] %}
        {% endfor %}
        {{ ns.items | join(', ') }}
  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ low != '' }}"
    then:
      - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
        data:
          title: Batteries below 20%
          message: "{{ low }}"

recipes.title: Put the non-urgent things in the bell
recipes.yaml:
alias: Fern needs water
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "09:00:00"
    id: check
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.fern_moisture
    above: 40
    id: wet
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: check
          - condition: numeric_state
            entity_id: sensor.fern_moisture
            below: 25
        sequence:
          - action: persistent_notification.create
            data:
              notification_id: fern_dry
              title: Fern
              message: The fern is dry. Water it today.
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: wet
        sequence:
          - action: persistent_notification.dismiss
            data:
              notification_id: fern_dry

recipes.title: The one alert that should wake you: a freezer that is too warm
recipes.yaml:
alias: Freezer too warm
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.freezer_temperature
    above: -12
    for:
      minutes: 30
actions:
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Freezer
      message: >
        Freezer warmer than -12 for 30
        minutes. Check the door and the plug.
      data:
        push:
          sound:
            name: default
            critical: 1
            volume: 1.0
        ttl: 0
        priority: high

recipes.title: The bathroom fan follows the humidity
recipes.yaml:
alias: Bathroom fan follows humidity
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.bathroom_humidity
    above: 70
    id: humid
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.bathroom_humidity
    below: 60
    for:
      minutes: 5
    id: dry
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: humid
        sequence:
          - action: switch.turn_on
            target:
              entity_id: switch.bathroom_fan
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: dry
        sequence:
          - action: switch.turn_off
            target:
              entity_id: switch.bathroom_fan

recipes.title: Pre-heat the bathroom, but only on cold mornings
recipes.yaml:
alias: Pre-heat on cold mornings
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "05:30:00"
conditions:
  - condition: numeric_state
    entity_id: weather.home
    attribute: temperature
    below: 8
  - condition: state
    entity_id: input_select.house_mode
    state: Home
actions:
  - action: climate.set_temperature
    target:
      entity_id: climate.bathroom
    data:
      temperature: 22
      hvac_mode: heat

recipes.title: Lower the heating at night, restore it in the morning
recipes.yaml:
alias: Heating - night setback
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "22:30:00"
    id: night
  - trigger: time
    at: "06:00:00"
    id: morning
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: night
        sequence:
          - action: climate.set_preset_mode
            target:
              entity_id: climate.living_room
            data:
              preset_mode: eco
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: morning
        sequence:
          - action: climate.set_preset_mode
            target:
              entity_id: climate.living_room
            data:
              preset_mode: home

recipes.title: The charger switches itself off when the battery is full
recipes.yaml:
alias: Charger off when the battery is full
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.ebike_charger_power
    below: 3
    for:
      minutes: 10
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: switch.ebike_charger
    state: "on"
actions:
  - action: switch.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: switch.ebike_charger
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      message: The e-bike is charged. The plug is off.

recipes.title: A one-line energy summary every evening
recipes.yaml:
alias: Evening energy summary
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "21:00:00"
actions:
  - variables:
      kwh: >
        {{ states('sensor.daily_energy')
           | float(0) | round(1) }}
      cost: >
        {{ (states('sensor.daily_energy') | float(0)
            * states('input_number.price_per_kwh')
              | float(0)) | round(2) }}
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Today's electricity
      message: >
        {{ kwh }} kWh today, about {{ cost }}
        at your price.

recipes.title: Run the dishwasher when electricity is cheap
recipes.yaml:
alias: Dishwasher starts when power is cheap
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.electricity_price
    below: input_number.cheap_price_limit
    id: cheap
  - trigger: time
    at: "05:00:00"
    id: deadline
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: input_boolean.dishwasher_ready
    to: "on"
    id: ready
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: input_boolean.dishwasher_ready
    state: "on"
  - condition: template
    value_template: >
      {{ trigger.id == 'deadline'
         or states('sensor.electricity_price')
            | float(99)
            < states('input_number.cheap_price_limit')
              | float(0) }}
actions:
  - action: switch.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: switch.dishwasher_plug
  - action: input_boolean.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: input_boolean.dishwasher_ready

recipes.title: Use solar surplus for hot water
recipes.yaml:
alias: Solar surplus heats the boiler
triggers:
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.grid_power
    below: -1500
    for:
      minutes: 5
    id: surplus
  - trigger: numeric_state
    entity_id: sensor.grid_power
    above: 100
    for:
      minutes: 5
    id: end
conditions:
  - condition: time
    after: "10:00:00"
    before: "17:00:00"
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: surplus
          - condition: numeric_state
            entity_id: sensor.boiler_temperature
            below: 55
        sequence:
          - action: switch.turn_on
            target:
              entity_id: switch.boiler_plug
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: end
        sequence:
          - action: switch.turn_off
            target:
              entity_id: switch.boiler_plug

recipes.title: Make an empty house look lived in
recipes.yaml:
alias: Away simulation - evening lamp
triggers:
  - trigger: sun.sunset
    options:
      offset:
        minutes: 20
      offset_type: after
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: input_boolean.holiday_mode
    state: "on"
actions:
  - delay:
      minutes: "{{ range(0, 25) | random }}"
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: light.living_room_lamp
    data:
      brightness_pct: 50
  - delay:
      minutes: "{{ range(90, 150) | random }}"
  - action: light.turn_off
    target:
      entity_id: light.living_room_lamp

recipes.title: A siren with an entry delay and a cancel button
recipes.yaml:
alias: Entry alarm with a cancel window
mode: single
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.front_door
    to: "on"
conditions:
  - condition: state
    entity_id: input_boolean.alarm_armed
    state: "on"
actions:
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Front door
      message: Front door opened. Siren in 30 seconds.
      data:
        actions:
          - action: ALARM_CANCEL
            title: It was me
  - wait_for_trigger:
      - trigger: event
        event_type: mobile_app_notification_action
        event_data:
          action: ALARM_CANCEL
      - trigger: state
        entity_id: input_boolean.alarm_armed
        to: "off"
    timeout: "00:00:30"
  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ wait.trigger is none }}"
    then:
      - action: siren.turn_on
        target:
          entity_id: siren.hallway
      - delay:
          minutes: 3
      - action: siren.turn_off
        target:
          entity_id: siren.hallway

recipes.title: See who is at the door from the lock screen
recipes.yaml:
alias: Doorbell - picture on the phone
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.doorbell
    to: "on"
actions:
  - delay:
      seconds: 2
  - repeat:
      for_each:
        - notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
        - notify.mobile_app_ben_phone
      sequence:
        - action: "{{ repeat.item }}"
          data:
            title: Doorbell
            message: Somebody rang the bell.
            data:
              image: /api/camera_proxy/camera.front_door
              entity_id: camera.front_door

recipes.title: A leak closes the main water valve
recipes.yaml:
alias: Leak - close the main valve
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id:
      - binary_sensor.kitchen_leak
      - binary_sensor.laundry_leak
      - binary_sensor.bathroom_leak
    to: "on"
actions:
  - action: valve.close_valve
    target:
      entity_id: valve.main_water
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Water leak
      message: Water detected. The main valve is closed.
      data:
        tag: leak
        ttl: 0
        priority: high

recipes.title: Smoke detected: every light on and a loud message
recipes.yaml:
alias: Smoke - all lights on, alert phone
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id:
      - binary_sensor.smoke_hallway
      - binary_sensor.smoke_kitchen
    to: "on"
actions:
  - action: light.turn_on
    target:
      entity_id: all
    data:
      brightness_pct: 100
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Smoke
      message: Smoke detected at home. Check the house.
      data:
        push:
          sound:
            name: default
            critical: 1
            volume: 1.0
        ttl: 0
        priority: high

recipes.title: Ask your house: "Is anyone home?"
recipes.yaml:
alias: Assist - is anyone home?
triggers:
  - trigger: conversation
    command:
      - Is anyone home
      - Is somebody home
actions:
  - set_conversation_response: >
      {% set home = states.person
         | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'home')
         | map(attribute='name') | list %}
      {% if home %}
        Home right now: {{ home | join(' and ') }}.
      {% else %}
        Nobody is home.
      {% endif %}

recipes.title: A voice command with a number in it
recipes.yaml:
alias: Assist - study timer in minutes
triggers:
  - trigger: conversation
    command:
      - set the study timer to {minutes} minutes
actions:
  - action: timer.start
    target:
      entity_id: timer.study_timer
    data:
      duration: "{{ trigger.slots.minutes | int * 60 }}"
  - set_conversation_response: >
      Study timer set to
      {{ trigger.slots.minutes }} minutes.

recipes.title: A "dinner is ready" button for every speaker
recipes.yaml:
alias: Dinner call
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: input_button.dinner_call
actions:
  - action: assist_satellite.announce
    target:
      entity_id:
        - assist_satellite.kitchen
        - assist_satellite.living_room
    data:
      message: Dinner is ready.
      preannounce: true

recipes.title: A Monday list of everything that has gone quiet
recipes.yaml:
alias: Monday list of unavailable entities
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "09:00:00"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    weekday:
      - mon
actions:
  - variables:
      gone: >
        {{ states
           | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'unavailable')
           | map(attribute='entity_id')
           | list }}
  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ gone | count > 0 }}"
    then:
      - action: persistent_notification.create
        data:
          notification_id: unavailable_report
          title: Unavailable entities
          message: >
            {{ gone | count }} entities unavailable:
            {{ gone[:15] | join(', ') }}

recipes.title: Hear about a failed or missing backup
recipes.yaml:
alias: Backup problem
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: event.backup_automatic_backup
    id: event
  - trigger: time
    at: "09:30:00"
    id: age
conditions:
  - condition: template
    value_template: >
      {% if trigger.id == 'event' %}
        {{ trigger.to_state.attributes.event_type
           == 'failed' }}
      {% else %}
        {% set id = 'sensor.backup_last_' ~
                    'successful_automatic_backup' %}
        {{ (now() - states(id) | as_datetime(
              now() - timedelta(days=99))).days
           >= 2 }}
      {% endif %}
actions:
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Backup
      message: >
        The last automatic backup failed or is over
        two days old. Open Settings > System > Backups.

recipes.title: A Saturday note about waiting updates, with no automatic installing
recipes.yaml:
alias: Saturday update digest
triggers:
  - trigger: time
    at: "10:00:00"
conditions:
  - condition: time
    weekday:
      - sat
actions:
  - variables:
      waiting: >
        {{ states.update
           | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on')
           | map(attribute='name') | list }}
  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ waiting | count > 0 }}"
    then:
      - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
        data:
          title: Updates are waiting
          message: >
            {{ waiting | join(', ') }}.
            Make a backup first, then update in
            Settings > System > Updates.

recipes.title: Keep a note of how long the internet was down
recipes.yaml:
alias: Internet outage report
mode: single
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: binary_sensor.router_ping
    to: "off"
    for:
      minutes: 3
actions:
  - variables:
      since: "{{ trigger.to_state.last_changed }}"
  - wait_for_trigger:
      - trigger: state
        entity_id: binary_sensor.router_ping
        to: "on"
    timeout: "12:00:00"
  - action: persistent_notification.create
    data:
      title: Internet was down
      message: >
        Down from
        {{ as_local(as_datetime(since))
           .strftime('%H:%M') }},
        for about
        {{ ((now() - as_datetime(since))
            .total_seconds() / 60)
           | round(0) | int }} minutes.

recipes.title: Hear about a new error in the log, at most once an hour
recipes.yaml:
alias: Home Assistant logged an error
mode: single
triggers:
  - trigger: event
    event_type: system_log_event
    event_data:
      level: ERROR
actions:
  - action: notify.mobile_app_anna_phone
    data:
      title: Home Assistant error
      message: >
        {{ trigger.event.data.name }}:
        {{ (trigger.event.data.message | first)
           | string | truncate(150) }}
  - delay:
      hours: 1
